jobs.title: Assistant GIS Specialist
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Randstad Digital is seeking an Assistant GIS Specialist for an opportunity in Akron, OH. The Assistant Geographic Information Systems (GIS) Specialist supports the development, maintenance, analysis, and management of GIS data for a wide range of professional services. This role assists with GIS analysis, data development, data maintenance, and data preparation for use in GIS applications. A key responsibility of the position is providing excellent customer service by regularly communicating project status and collaborating with clients to ensure project objectives are met.

Working closely with cross-functional teams, the Assistant GIS Specialist delivers high-quality GIS data and services while demonstrating a strong commitment to teamwork, customer service, responsiveness, and continuous improvement.

location: Akron, Ohio

job type: Contract

salary: $28.00 - 31.68 per hour

work hours: 8am to 5pm

education: Bachelors

Responsibilities

Assist with GIS analysis, data development, data collection, and mapping for client projects while supporting both internal and external project teams.
Assist with GIS metadata creation, digital feature extraction, land survey record searches, and ownership data research from a variety of sources.
Assist with coordinate system projections and geospatial data transformations for project deliverables.
Assist in creating and updating GIS maps, map layers, and geospatial databases.
Assist with georeferencing raster and vector datasets.
Support ad-hoc analyses and provide recommendations to help achieve business goals related to quality, billability, and utilization.
Assist with quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) of GIS deliverables to ensure compliance with client and project requirements.
Utilize software applications and information from various sources (e.g., Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Excel, deeds, field notes, and other project documentation) to develop GIS maps supporting field personnel and client deliverables.
Regularly communicate project status with project teams and clients to support successful project execution.
Ensure compliance with company and site safety policies.

Qualifications

Job Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Geography, Geomatics, Computer Science, or a closely related field.
GIS Professional (GISP) certification or an ESRI technical certification is preferred but not required.
Ability to work independently while demonstrating accuracy, reliability, sound judgment, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work methodically and analytically in a quantitative problem-solving environment with demonstrated critical thinking skills.
Basic proficiency with ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online (AGOL), and Microsoft Office applications.
Strong attention to detail with excellent organizational, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Demonstrated initiative and the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
Prior internship and/or related consulting experience is preferred.
Minimum GPA of 3.0 is strongly preferred.
A master's degree in a related field may be substituted for one year of experience.
Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States as a U.S. Citizen or Lawful Permanent Resident (Green Card holder).
Travel required: Approximately 5%.

Skills & Knowledge

ArcGIS Pro
ArcGIS Online (AGOL)
Esri Enterprise and other Esri products
ArcPy and basic Python scripting
Microsoft Office Suite
GIS data management and cartography
Technical writing
Project coordination
Quality assurance/quality control (QA/QC)
Strong verbal and written communication skills

Equal Opportunity Employer: Race, Color, Religion, Sex, Sexual Orientation, Gender Identity, National Origin, Age, Genetic Information, Disability, Protected Veteran Status, or any other legally protected group status.

At Randstad Digital, we welcome people of all abilities and want to ensure that our hiring and interview process meets the needs of all applicants. If you require a reasonable accommodation to make your application or interview experience a great one, please contact HRsupport@randstadusa.com.

Pay offered to a successful candidate will be based on several factors including the candidate's education, work experience, work location, specific job duties, certifications, etc. In addition, Randstad Digital offers a comprehensive benefits package, including: medical, prescription, dental, vision, AD&D, and life insurance offerings, short-term disability, and a 401K plan (all benefits are based on eligibility).

This posting is open for thirty (30) days.

jobs.title: Sr. Data Analyst/ Family Court Program Evaluator (2026-04)
jobs.description:
Senior Program Evaluator / Data Analyst — Family Treatment Court Outcomes Study
We are looking for an expert Data Analyst who can also perform Business and Systems Analysis. This is remote work, about 600-ish hours over 18 months, with opportunity to extend and grow the work over another year.

There are two major portions of the work: business methods/process, cost feasibility, HIPAA/42 CFR Part 2 credibility analysis; and separately dashboards, data stories, accessibility compliance analysis.

This is meaningful, high-visibility work at the intersection of courts, child welfare, and behavioral health — with a small, well-defined dataset, a collaborative multidisciplinary client team, and a mandate to build reporting tools the program can sustain after the engagement ends.

What You'll Do

Lead the analysis of multi-source program data (court records, treatment history, drug testing, placement and permanency data, service referrals, hearing attendance) for a cohort of approximately 25–39 families
Build a data inventory, identify gaps and quality issues, and design practical, repeatable data collection and reporting workflows the court can maintain independently
Conduct descriptive analysis — and inferential or comparative analysis where methodologically defensible given small sample sizes — with honest, well-documented limitations
Assess the feasibility of a full or partial cost analysis (cost avoidance, ROI, or partial cost approaches) and, if approved, design and execute the methodology
Collect qualitative input from program families to fill data gaps, using trauma-informed practices
Produce analysis reports, dashboards, reporting templates, and narrative "data stories" that non-technical audiences — judges, caseworkers, CASA volunteers, treatment providers, funders — can actually use
Present findings to program Steering and Oversight teams twice per year and provide ongoing consultation and office hours to the Statewide FTC Coordinator
Deliver a complete handover package (data dictionaries, methodology documentation, editable templates, workflow instructions) at contract close

Required Qualifications

5+ years of experience analyzing sensitive program data in courts, child welfare, behavioral health, substance use treatment, public health, or human services
Working knowledge of HIPAA, 42 CFR Part 2, and secure handling of confidential data (encryption, role-based access, de-identification)
Demonstrated experience working with small, incomplete, multi-source datasets — and communicating limitations responsibly
Strong data visualization and reporting skills; ability to build dashboards, templates, and infographics in accessible, editable formats
Excellent plain-language writing; a portfolio including reports, visualizations, slide decks, or data stories for non-technical audiences
Proficiency with statistical/analytical tools (R, Python, Stata, SPSS, or equivalent) and visualization/reporting platforms (Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or equivalent)
Experience managing deliverable-driven projects with multiple stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

Prior evaluation of Family Treatment Courts, drug courts, recovery courts, or other multidisciplinary treatment court programs
Experience with judicial branch, DCYF/child welfare agency, CASA, or grant-funded program data
Experience conducting cost analysis, cost avoidance, or ROI studies for public-sector or human services programs
Familiarity with federal grant reporting (OJP/OJJDP performance measures a plus)
Section 508 / WCAG accessibility knowledge for deliverables
Experience supporting continuous quality improvement and sustainability planning

To Apply:

Submit your resume, and 2-3 work samples from similar projects that demonstrate your abilities such as reports, dashboards, data visualizations, or data stories.

Employment type

Part-time

Consulting and Information Technology

Industries

Technology, Information and Media and Data Infrastructure and Analytics
